messages:
sara_support: Incoming quota/rate request from AcmeRetail — they want 5x burst for checkout embeddings during Black Friday tests. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/7892
eli_sales: They signed an NDA, paying customer (Growth plan). Wants it for a 48h window next week for load testing.
mike_product: Do we have any fraud signals? 5x is big. Need expected RPS, token distribution, and whether requests are authenticated.
sara_support: Authenticated via API key. Customer provided expected peak: 150 req/s, avg token per request 1200. Current cap is 30 req/s.
fraud-bot: Alert: IP pool associated with this API key had 3 failed billing events and 1 suspicious account creation pattern in last 30 days. Score: 68/100.
nana_engineer: (typo correction) sorry, i'm ana_engineer — that IP note worries me. Can we get recent request IDs + sample payloads to scan for scraping patterns?
sara_support: Attached in ticket: logs + sample request IDs (see ticket). Also pasted small log excerpt: 
```
2026-03-12T14:02:11Z api-key=acct_45 req_id=req_6a1 tokens=1187 model=emi-3 status=200 region=us-west
2026-03-12T14:02:12Z api-key=acct_45 req_id=req_6a2 tokens=1245 model=emi-3 status=200 region=us-west
2026-03-12T14:02:13Z api-key=acct_45 req_id=req_6a3 tokens=5000 model=emi-3 status=200 region=us-west
```
ana_engineer: That third line looks like a spike — might be a single long request or abuse.
eli_sales: Customer insists it's legitimate: it's a merged document search + embeddings pipeline. They can throttle client-side but want server-side guarantee for tests.
mike_product: Proposed triage: 1) Temporary limited uplift (2x) with telemetry/monitoring and webhook alerts; 2) Onboarding checklist for permanent increase: billing verification, KYC for billing contact, and a short probe-run for two weeks; 3) If any abuse signals, auto-revert to baseline and require manual review. Thoughts?
nana_engineer: Agree on probe-run. For implementation we can add a scoped rate override for the key (ephemeral override id) that expires automatically. Minimal infra work: a small feature flag + rate table entry. Estimate: ~2 engineer-days to implement and QA.
ops_oncall: Need fail-safe: if concurrent errors > 5% in a 1m window, rollback auto. Also require anotated logs to link to ticket id.
qa_lead: QA will need test harness + synthetic load script. I can prep the test plan if product signs off.
eli_sales: Customer will accept 2x temporary uplift for the window if we do monitoring. Can we get that done before next Tuesday?
mike_product: Timeline tight. Options: A) manual temporary uplift by Support (fast, no infra) but limited observability; B) ephemeral scoped override (safer, slightly slower). Which do we pick?
sara_support: We can do manual uplift now as short-term to keep the customer and buy time, but prefer option B for product/ops.
mike_product: Let's do both: manual uplift for the immediate requested window (48h) with strict monitoring and auto-revert flagged in runbook, while Ana and Eng implement the ephemeral override in parallel for permanent flow. Acceptance criteria for permanent change: documented audit logs, KYC completed, automated abuse detection firing thresholds, and a rollback policy.
nana_engineer: I'll own the override feature. ETA 2 business days if nothing blocks.
ops_oncall: I'll author the rollback runbook and add the alert rule: 
```
alert: quota_uplift_error_spike
expr: increase(api_request_errors_total[1m]) > 5
for: 1m
annotations:
  ticket: "7892"
  owner: "ops_oncall"
```
mike_product: Product backlog item created: RB-4123 "ephemeral scoped quota overrides + monitoring". Fields: scope=api_key, expires, audit_log_id, auto-revert. Priority: P1 for customer-facing quota flows.
eli_sales: Thanks — can you tag it with customer impact and expected ARR? I'll update the account execs.
sara_support: Also note fraud-bot score — do we want a manual fraud review before permanent increase?
mike_product: Yes. Add a precondition: pass fraud review (fraud-bot score < 50 or manual sign-off). If review fails, require security + sales call.
nana_engineer: I'll include a hook so fraud-bot signals are attached to audit logs.
ops_oncall: Who is doing the manual 48h uplift? We need an owner for the weekend window.
sara_support: I can apply manual uplift and monitor for the next 48h, escalate to ops_oncall if alerts trigger.
qa_lead: I'll run the synthetic load during the uplift and report latency/cost delta.
mike_product: Good. Next steps summary: 1) sara_support applies manual 48h 2x uplift now and posts status in ticket (owner=sara_support). 2) ana_engineer implements ephemeral override (owner=ana_engineer, ETA 2 business days). 3) ops_oncall writes rollback runbook + alerts (owner=ops_oncall). 4) fraud review required before permanent increase (owner=mike_product + fraud team). 5) QA runs synthetic load and reports metrics (owner=qa_lead).
eli_sales: Customer notified and happy with plan. :thumbsup:
sara_support: Manual uplift applied at 2026-03-12T15:04Z (details in ticket). Monitoring hook enabled.
fraud-bot: Note added to ticket: manual review requested by mike_product.
mike_product: Thanks team. I'll keep RB-4123 as P1 and update acceptance criteria as we go. If any alerts fire, ping @ops_oncall and escalate to security.
ops_oncall: Acknowledged. Will watch the dashboard for the next 48h and run rollback if needed.
nana_engineer: Will post PR link and small design doc in the ticket when ready.
eli_sales: Closing loop with customer — thanks everyone.
